title: 20 Filter layers, masks, fills and flats

bites.title: Non-destructive magic
bites.body: Filter layers and masks change how things look without touching the pixels. Delete them and the original is untouched.

bites.title: The value checker
bites.body: Layer > New > Add Filter Layer, pick Desaturate. Instantly your color painting is black and white. Painters keep this on top and toggle it to check values.

bites.title: Filter mask
bites.body: Select Apple, then Layer > New > Add Filter Mask (try HSV Adjustment). The filter applies to just that one layer.

bites.title: Transparency mask
bites.body: Layer > New > Add Transparency Mask on Apple. Paint black on the mask to hide, white to reveal. An eraser with an undo button built in.

bites.title: Fill tool with gap closing
bites.body: Press {key:KritaFill/KisToolFill|F}. In Tool Options, look for the gap-closing setting: it seals small gaps in your line art so the fill doesn't leak.

bites.title: Colorize mask for flats
bites.body: On line art, the Colorize Mask lets you scribble a dab of color in each region and Krita fills the flats for you. Layer > New > Add Colorize Mask.

bites.title: 20 cleared
bites.body: Filter layers, filter masks, transparency masks, gap-closing fills, colorize masks. Non-destructive is the professional default.
